nodes.text:
Aurelius remains on his knees beside the amber sarcophagus, his calcified fingers tracing the fingernail-marks Caelia left on the underside of the glass three centuries ago.

"All these years, I was so terrified that looking closely would wake her into pain that I never read her last words to me," he whispers. "Step up to the Great Brazier when you are ready, {player.name}. Whether you relight the Sun, tune the Moon, or restore the Skull I chiseled away... I will not raise my hand again."
"The Great Brazier awaits your hand, {player.name}. Let the third verse be spoken at last."
